description: Fetch the brand's audience intelligence / ICP (ideal customer profile). short = compact summary (name + primaryRoles + top painPoints + persona.role); medium adds positioning + fuller demographics; full = the raw payload (audienceData + positioning + persona + contentModulation). `persona` is the ghostwriter persona ({ role, styleNotes, ... }) and may be null. If the brand has no audience data yet, run website/audience analysis (onboarding) first.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "full". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: get_audience
